- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>

- **Onboarding Teams**: They have received feedback that unannounced screen changes cause confusion and delays, highlighting a need for advance notice [i:1510a29a4fb29690].

- **Stannary Commercial** (ARR GBP 540000.0) said unexpected changes forced mid-cycle retraining, causing errors in claims and payments processing [i:3a4ae29f32b5253f]. They emphasized the need for predictability so staff don't have to keep relearning [i:7dccff3918b6f081].
- **Linnet House Insurance** (ARR GBP 360000.0) reported having to retrain three people because a button moved, leading to an erroneous payment submission [i:71a03e5a571c2a63]. They also stated that a Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning, requiring mid-week retraining [i:9c432aa4bd712320].
- **Callowfield Auto Assurance** (ARR GBP 1250000.0) said unannounced screen changes are hurting efficiency and they need advance notice to adapt [i:695ce5df664b4bfc]. They also noted that controls moving without warning forces constant retraining [i:bd1bd40a6ba477f6].
- **Wexmoor Motor** (ARR GBP 1950000.0) reported that an update moved the reserves button, requiring retraining for half the team [i:3c7de4adbd5cede1]. They also stated that key controls moved without warning, forcing staff retraining [i:eaed2dbae41acac5].
- **Hollinbrook Home Insurance** (ARR GBP 2400000.0) said their teams had to retrain because of unexpected interface changes and they are still seeing errors from it [i:86e3ed2f99935808].
- **Brindlecombe Home** (ARR not specified) echoed the need for fewer surprises and more notice before major shifts [i:ad38c9f354762a62].
- The total ARR represented by the accounts with specified values is GBP 7360000.0 [i:27a70a943d3863cd][i:3a4ae29f32b5253f][i:71a03e5a571c2a63][i:695ce5df664b4bfc][i:3c7de4adbd5cede1][i:86e3ed2f99935808].

## Why Now
- Three accounts have renewals due within the next 90 days as of 2026-11-03: Stannary Commercial (2026-12-05), Hollinbrook Home Insurance (2027-01-15), and Quillon Business Insurance (2027-01-20) [i:27a70a943d3863cd][i:3a4ae29f32b5253f][i:86e3ed2f99935808].

- The repeated calls for advance notice, previews, and bundled releases from multiple routes suggest that the current pattern of unannounced changes is unsustainable for customer operations [i:1510a29a4fb29690][i:3a4ae29f32b5253f][i:5ed8a4c145f561c2][i:695ce5df664b4bfc].
